basics.name: Girish Kulathumani
basics.summary: Computer Science and Engineering graduate (VIT Chennai, 2025). Research interests: decoding non-invasive biosignals (EEG and wrist surface EMG) so that models trained on some people work on new ones with little or no calibration; personalising shared models without pooling each person's data, using federated learning; and evaluation with subject-wise splits that rules out data leakage.

work.summary: Built Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud features (Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows) for a global pharmaceutical client.
highlights: Evaluated GitHub Copilot on real user stories, reporting over 80% average time savings, which fed into the licence decision
Wrote a 60-page onboarding guide adopted by teams in India and the Philippines

work.company: Vellore Institute of Technology, Chennai (on the university's NVIDIA DGX)
work.summary: Led a three-person team building HabitatFL, a federated framework for classifying wildlife audio and images across separate clients, with Flower and Docker on multi-GPU infrastructure.
highlights: Trained lightweight edge models (MobileNetV3, SqueezeNet, under 2 MB): 87.65% accuracy on 18.2K spectrograms (27 classes) and 69.92% on 50K images (82 classes) (code)

work.position: Research Assistant, Secure Systems and AI
work.summary: Research on secure messaging and deception-based defence, leading to two peer-reviewed papers.
highlights: Designed and implemented JIGS, a secure-messaging pipeline combining ECDH key exchange with nonce-based AES-128 and parallelised stages, with its protocol verified in ProVerif (code)
Contributed to Siren, a deception-based defence pairing honeypots and simulated user activity with ML classification of attacker behaviour

work.summary: Built a real-time weapon-detection system on live video with YOLO and Flask, in a team of three.

projects.name: Enterprise Banking System (Full-Stack)
projects.description: Comprehensive banking system with REST API, modern frontend, and containerized deployment.
highlights: Developing REST API with FastAPI and SQLAlchemy ORM for role-based access and ACID-safe transactions
Building React + TypeScript frontend with Material UI, JWT authentication, and Axios interceptors
Containerized with Docker Compose, CI/CD via GitHub Actions, 85% test coverage with pytest

projects.name: GPU-Accelerated Financial News Sentiment
projects.description: Streamed news through Kafka and scored it with FinBERT, using RAPIDS cuDF on an RTX 2060 to cut end-to-end latency from about 8 minutes to 10 seconds.

projects.name: LSTM Time-Series Forecasting for Mutual Funds
projects.description: Advanced ML pipeline for financial forecasting with comprehensive feature engineering.
highlights: Built ML pipeline integrating live NAV API data with S&P BSE Tech index for next-day forecasting
Engineered 15+ financial features (RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, CAPM metrics) achieving MAE 0.3-0.8
Applied sliding window preprocessing and feature selection using mutual information scoring

projects.name: JIGSaw - Modular Parallelised Secure Messaging Architecture
projects.description: High-performance cryptographic communication framework with parallelized execution.
highlights: Designed and implemented parallelized high-performance cryptographic communication system achieving 96.67% speedup
Developed modular Python architecture with ECDH/AES-128 pipeline and TCP socket implementation

projects.name: YOLO Weapon Detection System
projects.description: Real-time computer vision system for security applications.
highlights: Built real-time weapon detection system using YOLO + Flask with optimized TensorFlow inference
Deployed web application for real-time webcam-based weapon classification

publications.name: JIGS: a modular parallel encryption and authentication pipeline for secure messaging
publications.authors: G. Kulathumani, S. V. Madangarli, J. Ullas, I. Agarwal, et al.
publications.summary: A secure-messaging pipeline combining ECDH key exchange with nonce-based AES-128 and parallelised stages, with its protocol verified in ProVerif.

publications.name: Siren: Advancing cybersecurity through deception and adaptive analysis
publications.publisher: Intelligent Computing: Proceedings of the Computing Conference, pp. 506–519, Springer LNNS
publications.summary: A deception-based defence pairing honeypots and simulated user activity with ML classification of attacker behaviour. Preprint: arXiv:2406.06225.

initiatives.name: GreyLattice
initiatives.description: Independent publication on brain–computer interfaces and computational neuroscience: around ten posts, including long technical deep dives, e.g. a breakdown of real-time MEG decoding of visual perception (arXiv:2310.19812) and an explainer on the limits of non-invasive brain recording. Built and run the publication's own site (Astro, TypeScript, Keystatic CMS).

current.name: EEG/EMG Foundation Challenge, NeurIPS 2026 (Track 2: EEG decoding)
current.summary: Independent entry: a covariance-based EEG decoder (Riemannian tangent space with logistic regression), written without AI-generated code and evaluated on held-out participants.
